annotations.label: T cells (CD4-like predominant; naive/memory split unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD3D (87% of cells) and CD3E (76%) are strongly enriched, with LDHB. The near-identical res_0p3 cluster 0 had IL7R in 66% of cells, CD8A in 12% and CCR7 in 36%. That suggests CD4-predominant T cells (inference). The abstracts support CD3D/CD3E as T-cell genes but not LDHB. Naive versus memory is unresolved.

annotations.label: CD14+ classical monocytes (small DC admixture likely)
annotations.notes: Computed: S100A8, S100A9, LYZ, FCN1 and CD14 are strongly enriched (CD14 in 63% of cells vs 2.5% elsewhere). Abstracts support CD14+ monocytes and S100A8/S100A9 in classical monocytes. They do not support LGALS2 or FCN1. The overlap table shows 36 cells were the FCER1A+ CLEC10A+ DC-like group at res_0p3. That group is probably the UMAP tail.

annotations.label: Cytotoxic lymphocytes (NK cells and CD8+ effector T cells, mixed)
annotations.notes: Computed: cytotoxic genes are strongly enriched (NKG7 in 99% of cells). Also FGFBP2, GZMH and KLRD1. The near-identical res_0p3 cluster had CD3D in 60%, CD8A in 36% and KLRF1 in 12%, so NK and CD8 T cells are probably mixed. The abstracts support NKG7/GNLY/PRF/GZMB as cytotoxic genes, not an NK versus T split.

annotations.label: B cells
annotations.notes: Computed: CD79A (94% of cells), MS4A1 and CD79B are strongly enriched, with MHC class II genes (HLA-DQA1, HLA-DRA), TCL1A and FCER2. This suggests a naive-like B subset (inference, not tested). PMID 38770541 names CD79A and MS4A1 as B-cell markers, but in a CLL context, so scope is limited. Distinct UMAP island.

annotations.label: FCGR3A+ (CD16+) non-classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: FCGR3A (91% of cells vs 14%), MS4A7, CDKN1C, LILRA3 and CSF1R are enriched, with myeloid genes LST1 and FCER1G. The abstracts support FCGR3A+ monocytes as a PBMC subset but not MS4A7, CDKN1C or LILRA3. CD14 was not examined here. Sits next to cluster 1 on the UMAP.
